title: LLM Recovery Proposal
description: A single constrained proposal from the LLM recovery agent. The LLM proposes and interprets only; it never drives actuators and never asserts numeric feasibility (MISSION.md section 7). Sent to the model server as the structured-output schema and re-checked in Python after parsing.

mode.description: Requested recovery mode, from the fixed state-machine vocabulary (MISSION.md section 8). The LLM may only request.

rationale.description: Short justification citing evidence. Bounded so a runaway generation cannot fill the log.

requested_checks.description: Checks the LLM asks the numerical planner and validator to run before its plan is considered. The LLM cannot mark these as passed. Unique members only.

parameters.description: Action parameters. All numeric fields are bounded; the validator re-checks them against the vehicle's budget. The LLM may propose, never assert.
